name: emit the single-line result artifact
definition: write a one-line UTF-8 text file at the required path.
failure_mode: missing, multiline, or whitespace noise fails the exact-match test

name: encode a chess legal-move generator as a pipelined regex transform
definition: Build an ordered sequence of regex pairs that, applied to a starting FEN string, enumerates all legal next positions (one per line) without an ordinary program loop.
failure_mode: Missing or duplicated moves break the exact set-parity assertion.

name: encode an input stream respecting the decoder's token grammar
definition: Generate a valid token sequence (literals or back-references with offset and length) that the decoder re-expands to the full original text, following its exact variable-width integer encodings.
failure_mode: An invalid or mis-formatted token sequence produces wrong bytes or early termination.

name: enforce simultaneous multi-person availability and business-hours window
definition: Apply per-person availability, per-day departure limits, a lunch break, day-of-week restrictions, and the weekday business-hours window simultaneously when scanning candidate slots.
failure_mode: Violating any hard boundary disqualifies the meeting to pass the constraint function.
